recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit the BDP module page only if the work group separately decides the final navigation/location for the module or changes the R6 feedback request.
issue_request: FHIR-49944 was an Applied/Persuasive R6 clarification asking that the BiologicallyDerivedProduct Scope and Usage reference to the BDP module page be styled as a pink Note to Implementers, and that the top of the Biologically Derived Product module page contain implementer-note text about context, traceability requirements, medical products of human origin, and requested feedback.
initial_application: PR #3344 applied the issue before this reconciliation. Commit b9950a83192b55e15cda69cfac823769b0ef203c added the requested stu-note to source/biologically-derived-product-module.html and converted the resource introduction's module-page reference to a stu-note labeled Note to Implementers; merge commit 6e59399954659f029ef2f1ec37158f64591b7ba9 brought the PR into the main history. Commit f33813f7ff66e9df7908801b3ed4e7a5eb1c98fc added the WG-approved future-location/navigation sentence to the module note.
additional_context: BiologicallyDerivedProduct is active in source/fhir.ini, and the module page is wired into current source navigation through source/hierarchy.xml, source/modules-fragment.html, source/modules-list.html, and the BiologicallyDerivedProduct introduction. OO Main minutes on 2025-03-06 record a 13-0-0 motion to add the ticket content with the future-location/navigation sentence; HCP minutes on 2025-03-31 record FHIR-49944 as Persuasive and already applied in the build with a 7-0-1 vote. Zulip search found no relevant or conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the active current source already satisfies both parts of the Jira request and retains the later WG-approved addition.
